items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: Marinet, another sargeant, that there was going to be a civil war

ctx.x: ....so there was a revolution in August, 1933. He left. They put one president, they changed one president to the other in one day. They put one president, you know, the interim president and they wasn't satisfied and the army took over in one way and all the officials, the generals, the colonels and everybody, they put themselves at the Hotel Nacional because they wasn't satisfied with the president or

the revolutionary tool; so in that particular way, the army was like an orphan, there was nobody to take care of the army. So Batista saw, and Marinet, another sargeant, that there was going to be a civil war, so Batista got his teletype and get in communication with every, every person in the country and say "Don"t leave the army, go out into the street" and, you know, like quarantine or whatever......
